note: Re-judged 2026-11-19 after 3977cef525 (AC-21, judge-approved test changes). RFC 4301 Section 4.4.2.1: "Anti-Replay Window: a 64-bit counter and a bit-map (or equivalent) used to determine whether an inbound AH or ESP packet is a replay." Both tagged units now build the state with boundaryInboundSA (Dir SADirIn), because the window belongs to the receiving state and xfrmStateFromParams now refuses a nonzero window on an outbound state, as Linux verify_newsa_info does. Assertions are unchanged: TestRFC4301BoundarySADEntryCarriesWhatTheKernelLooksUp requires ReplayWindow 64 on the built entry; TestRFC4301SADItemAntiReplayWindowIsInstalled requires windows 32 and 64 as given. installChildDataplane sets ReplayWin on the inbound state alone. Builder-level; the kernel performs the replay check on the window Ze installs. Single polarity as annotated, but the annotation's "so no input is refused" no longer holds literally: a window on an outbound or forward-direction state is refused (TestXFRMStateReplayWindowOnlyOnTheReceivingSA, untagged), which is not an inbound replay case. Verdict stands.
